title: Conflicting unqualified LMS bundle price
current_behavior: Hero advertises ₹1,900 (₹3,300 struck through); same page and /pricing display ₹3,300 incl. GST
why_it_matters: Visitors cannot know which offer applies
proposed_improvement: Owner confirms intended offer; display authoritative current course/offer data consistently, with explicit conditions if a real discount exists
dependencies: Owner offer decision; existing LMS price/offer source
risk: Do not change financial prices, validate coupons or conflate Workspace catalog; live checkout was not tested

title: Lifetime course promise conflicts with 365-day access
current_behavior: Explicit lifetime course access vs 365 Days Access badges on all five local cards
why_it_matters: Commercial entitlement expectations conflict
proposed_improvement: Confirm intended access policy; replace contradictory marketing with accurate existing entitlement wording
risk: No entitlement-rule change; distinguish account/dashboard access from paid course duration

title: Homepage has no Workspace product introduction
current_behavior: Creator product appears in shared navigation/footer, not homepage body
why_it_matters: Aviation experts cannot quickly discover the new offer
proposed_improvement: Add concise dedicated Workspace block while retaining learner-first homepage
risk: Do not turn entire website Creator-only or promise public sales

title: Workspace navigation disappears at 1024px
current_behavior: Desktop nav starts at lg, Workspace starts at xl, menu ends at lg
why_it_matters: Direct creator discovery is lost at desktop/tablet width
proposed_improvement: Keep Workspace accessible across all breakpoints; fit or use compact navigation
risk: Preserve all LMS/account links; no authentication changes

title: Narrow header logo and theme hitboxes overlap
current_behavior: 320px actual-loaded logo and theme control overlap horizontally
why_it_matters: Ambiguous targets and crowded brand presentation
proposed_improvement: Reflow mobile header; reduce competing top-row actions and reserve logo width
risk: No fragile hidden controls; preserve theme/account access

title: Primary CTA and navigation contrast defects
current_behavior: Light-mode Student Sign In is white on white; other sampled purple text is too pale
why_it_matters: Sign-in action becomes visually unreadable
proposed_improvement: Use accessible shared button/text tokens; verify light/dark contrast
dependencies: Design token approval and shared-button checks
risk: Fix scoped usage; avoid global color changes without full regression

title: Carousel exposes inactive links and keeps rotating during keyboard focus
current_behavior: Tab enters aria-hidden inactive slide; focused course rotates after six seconds; no pause control
why_it_matters: Keyboard and assistive-technology navigation diverge
proposed_improvement: Prefer static featured course or accessible carousel: inactive inert/tab suppression, focus pause, explicit pause/resume and stable labels
risk: Existing hover/reduced-motion behavior is positive; do not remove usable course navigation

title: Early Access capability hierarchy is outdated
current_behavior: Broad planned course business leads; creator tools described as in development; actual preparation scope and dates buried
why_it_matters: Visitors cannot distinguish available private tools from future media/publication/sales
proposed_improvement: Lead with profile/proposal/review/approved private text builder; mark future release as targeted 9 November subject to readiness; keep payments disabled notice
dependencies: Owner-approved release copy; actual launch status
risk: No media/publication controls or claim that paid launch has been enabled

title: Membership costs and paid-term start are undiscoverable pre-application
current_behavior: Durations/GST mentioned without public amounts; no clear pre-launch term-start summary
why_it_matters: Commercial expectations require sign-in and eligibility first
proposed_improvement: Public read-only summary: 3/6/12 months ₹5,899/₹9,999/₹17,699 incl. GST; immediate authorized Early Access vs paid term beginning 9 November for pre-launch memberships
dependencies: Use authoritative current catalog; owner presentation decision
risk: No historical repricing or public checkout; honor complimentary access as a separate entitlement source

title: Workspace policy names are not links and refund summary is absent
current_behavior: Creator Terms/Refund Policy named as plain text; footer generic terms only; no 72-hour explanation
evidence: accessibility-seo-details.json legal; browser-evidence.json Workspace section 7 links=[]
why_it_matters: Important rights are difficult to find before activation
proposed_improvement: Link existing public Workspace legal routes and concise canonical-policy-aligned 72-hour request-window/support summary
dependencies: Canonical policy review; owner approves summary
risk: Window is from authoritative paidAt, not launch; do not edit legal text or obscure rights

title: Crawler endpoints redirect to login HTML
current_behavior: /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return 307 /login, then 200 HTML
why_it_matters: Crawler control and sitemap discovery are not valid at these endpoints
proposed_improvement: Provide public metadata routes and narrowly permit them in middleware while protecting all private routes
dependencies: Owner F.7B approval; public URL inventory; authorization regressions
risk: Do not broaden middleware bypass to private Creator/Admin routes; no claim that pages are completely unindexable

title: Shared Workspace header steers visitors back to LMS purchases
current_behavior: Get Started → /courses and Pricing → /pricing, even on Workspace
why_it_matters: Generic labels compete with creator application/membership journey
proposed_improvement: Make product context explicit: Learner courses/pricing, Workspace and Check eligibility; retain established destinations
risk: No new nonexistent routes; do not expose payment CTA

title: Public eligibility explanation omits concrete requirements
current_behavior: Aviation category list and short eligibility check, but no declaration/experience/profile/declarations summary
why_it_matters: Applicants cannot self-assess readiness
proposed_improvement: Show concise current published criteria and HTTPS professional-profile expectation; derive any configurable thresholds from authoritative policy
dependencies: Published eligibility policy/read-only DTO if needed
risk: 18+ and ≥24 months are source defaults, not a newly fetched live policy; do not hardcode unverified values

title: Current private course-building workflow is unclear
current_behavior: Future publish/sell sequence precedes private proposal → review → approved text builder; paid email/legal steps omitted
why_it_matters: Users may expect automatic course approval or immediate sale
proposed_improvement: Explain normal account → eligibility → paid verified-email/agreement/membership path → profile/proposal → review → approved private builder
risk: No skipped guards or shortened approval path; eligibility does not create access

title: No Workspace FAQ or complimentary-path explanation
current_behavior: Only learner FAQ on homepage; grant access not explained publicly
why_it_matters: Repeated questions and payment-only access assumption
proposed_improvement: Concise Workspace FAQ: who applies, payment-disabled state, review, private tools, target launch, refunds/support; explain owner-issued complimentary access where appropriate
risk: Complimentary access uses existing eligibility/current Terms and persisted Admin grant, no invented self-grant or paid-refund obligation

title: Repeated sections inflate page length
location: eleven home sections; nine Workspace sections
current_behavior: Features/heritage/faculty/outcomes recur; very long stacked mobile pages
why_it_matters: Core next steps require excessive scanning
proposed_improvement: Consolidate repeated benefits and proof; move release/commercial information earlier; keep important disclosures
risk: Do not remove required disclosure or all learner context; no measured conversion-rate claim

title: Credibility claims need owner evidence
current_behavior: Repeated IIM alumni and 30+ year heritage without linked person-level substantiation
why_it_matters: Visitors have limited verifiable context for assertions
proposed_improvement: Use verified faculty biographies, accurate organizational timeline and existing certificate demonstration
risk: Claims are unverified by audit, not declared false; no fabricated institutional endorsements/testimonials

title: Visual asset provenance is undocumented
location: public CDN logo/course images; public icons
current_behavior: Existing source usage is visible, licensing trail not located
why_it_matters: Reuse in redesign needs rights and brand assurance
proposed_improvement: Owner confirms logo/course/certificate artwork rights and approved brand lockup; retain licensed Lucide notices
risk: No new imagery generated or downloaded into repo; source presence alone is not rights proof

title: Resource and server/client boundaries merit measured optimization
current_behavior: Five hero images preload; raw huge logo; three font families; full published course records fetched dynamically and sent to client
why_it_matters: Avoidable payload/load work may grow with catalog
proposed_improvement: One prioritized hero image, appropriately sized licensed logo, lazy inactive/below-fold assets, explicit dimensions, minimal public course fields; profile before further caching/font/client changes
dependencies: Real optimizer test environment, F6-04 correction where relevant
risk: Local timings are not production CWV or a proven regression; never cache private data or rewrite analytics during F7B

title: Source fallback conflates unavailable data with empty catalog
current_behavior: DB error becomes [] then No courses found / try category, even when no filters render
evidence: Source review only; happy path browser contains five courses
why_it_matters: Unavailable service can look like no product inventory
proposed_improvement: Separate public-data unavailable and genuine-empty states; clear retry/browse/support path
risk: No fault injected into local DB; do not fabricate product availability

title: Canonical/social metadata is absent
current_behavior: Title/descriptions present; no canonical, OG/Twitter or structured data observed
why_it_matters: Sharing and preferred public URL identity lack explicit definition
proposed_improvement: Route-specific accurate metadata/canonical/social preview; structured data only for substantiated existing entity/course data
dependencies: Owner canonical domain and approved preview asset
risk: No SEO improvement claimed; no fabricated review/rating schema or private route indexability

title: Semantics and explicit search labeling need refinement
current_behavior: Search relies on placeholder without label/aria-label; certificate H2→H4 jumps; homepage lacks Workspace-style skip link
why_it_matters: More predictable screen-reader and keyboard orientation
proposed_improvement: Add persistent programmatic search label, proper heading levels, skip-to-main and consistent focus targets
risk: Placeholder may be used as a fallback accessible name; no formal inaccessible-name certification claimed

title: AirBharath naming varies
location: HeroBanner and course copy; shared shell
current_behavior: AirBharath / Air Bharath / Airbharath and LMS/Workspace labels vary
why_it_matters: Weakens consistent brand recognition
proposed_improvement: Apply owner-approved AirBharath brand naming and distinct LMS/Workspace product labels
risk: Preserve legal names and historical immutable financial/legal evidence

title: Decoration and passive hover treatments compete with content
location: landing card grids and hero decorations
current_behavior: Repeated ornamental icons, hover effects and generous spacers
why_it_matters: Minor polish opportunity after hierarchy defined
proposed_improvement: Restrain nonessential decoration/animation; make interactive affordances correspond to actions
risk: Keep reduced-motion support and avoid broad shared primitive redesign
